basic_info.description: BUILT in Year 2002. Convenient located in a neighborhood mall with H-Mart, CHASE Bank, etc. A few minutes' walk to DLAY CITY BART station. Easy access to HYW 280, SFSU, Stonestown, Westlake and Serramonte Shopping Malls. Cozy 1 bedroom | 1 full bath unit.  1 deeded parking | In-unit laundry. Move-in condition. Enjoy a bright and open floor plan featuring generous living and dining areas, well-equipped kitchen. Limited units available on the market for sale in this complex.   Don't miss out on this amazing opportunity!
